target_claim: the admitted finite record is faithful on the four-state source
semantic_rule: pull the scalar effect backward by the exact transpose transport and span the resulting covectors

falsifier.required_behavior: zero records at times 0, 1, and 2, followed by a nonzero record at time 3

failure_conditions: the residual is not exactly the fourth basis direction
more or fewer than one added scalar record is required
the time-3 record fails to separate the preregistered hostile state
claim_boundary: Finite rational linear constructor only; no claim that arbitrary Marici pullbacks are linear observability problems.
